archetype: Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) mixed with Neo-Brutalist contrast
design_philosophy: Raw, honest interfaces prioritizing functional clarity. Combines soft, optimistic pastel tones with structural, unapologetic neo-brutalist elements (thick black borders, hard shadows). Emphasizes creator fit and audience analytics over vanity metrics.

surface_strategies.cards: Solid white background, border-2 border-[#0A0A0A], shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)], rounded-xl. Hover state translates up by 4px and increases shadow offset to [8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)].
surface_strategies.buttons: Primary buttons use #C6A2FF background with border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] and shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)]. Font is bold. Hover lifts and increases shadow.
surface_strategies.badges: Pill-shaped, solid pastel background, 1.5px black border, text-xs uppercase bold.
surface_strategies.inputs: Solid white, border-2 border-[#0A0A0A], ring-offset-0 focus-visible:ring-0 focus:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)] focus:-translate-y-1 transition-all rounded-lg

spacing_and_layout.general: Use generous padding (p-6, p-8, p-12) to create breathing room between the heavy brutalist borders.

grid_system.creator_profile: MODE B: 'CONTROL ROOM' Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Every metric (engagement rate, audience age, language) is an individual blocky card.

components_instructions.navigation: Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#FAFAFA] border-b-2 border-[#0A0A0A]. Includes Logo, Links, and a chunky CTA button.
components_instructions.search_filters: Sidebar or top bar using Shadcn Select and Checkboxes, customized with 2px borders and square checkmarks instead of rounded.
components_instructions.creator_cards: Features large portrait image (max-h-48 object-cover border-b-2 border-black), bold creator name, platform badges, and key metrics. The CTA 'Unlock Contact' is prominently displayed.
components_instructions.subscription_plans: 3 columns. Thick borders. The 'Pro' plan is highlighted with a pastel yellow background and a prominent 'Most Popular' brutalist tag overlapping the top border.
components_instructions.analytics_charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts with thick 3px stroke lines, no gradients. Solid fill colors. Hard grid lines.
components_instructions.admin_panel: Dense but clear layout using the same hard-border logic. Tables should have distinct borders for each row.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Elements with brutalist shadows physically move (-translate-y-1 or -translate-y-2) to make the shadow expand dynamically.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use quick, snappy transitions. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use a marquee or a chunky spinning block instead of a standard thin spinner.

accessibility.contrast: Extremely high contrast by default due to #0A0A0A text and borders on pastel/white backgrounds.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. Examples: data-testid='search-button', data-testid='creator-card-123', data-testid='unlock-contact-button'.
